n09.text:
O09 Page geometry
Crop, resize, page boxes and orientation for one or many pages (Organise › Page setup).
States: crop with numeric margins and the “content stays in the file” warning; resize dialog (scale, extend, anchor); certified file: constraint banner and the Apply anyway alert dialog naming the signature.
Todos: E2f, E2h

n10.text:
O10 Page labels editor
Define numbering ranges (roman front matter, arabic body, prefixed appendix) with a live preview.
States: valid ranges with preview; overlapping range error (doc).
Todos: E2g

n11.text:
O11 Bookmarks editor
Create, rename, nest, reorder, colour and retarget bookmarks in the Outline tab (Organise); generate a contents page; manage named destinations.
States: bookmark renamed inline with inspector; contents page dialog; named destinations dialog with an inline rename; empty (doc).
Todos: E3b

n12.text:
O12 Link editor
Draw a link area or link selected text (Edit › Link), then set its target: a page, a named destination, a web or email address.
States: text link to a page; drawn link with a javascript: address rejected; script link found in an opened file (doc).
Todos: E3c

n13.text:
O13 Initial view and article threads
Choose how the file opens in any reader (Organise › ⋯ › Initial view…); list and follow article threads in Read.
States: initial view dialog with changes; threads tab (280 px rail, More tabs) with a part selected.
Todos: E3d

n14.text:
O14 Attachments panel
See and save out embedded and associated files; adding, describing and deleting happen in Organise.
States: Read, one file selected, read-only with Edit in Organise; Organise editing, program warning, empty (doc).
Todos: E3f

n15.text:
O15 Object inspector
Read-only COS browser for power users: object tree, dictionary view, stream decoded or raw, revisions.
States: page object open with its content stream; stream over the size cap (doc).
Todos: E3g

n16.text:
O16 Export and extraction
Export pages as images, text, Markdown or JSON, original images, links and bookmarks.
States: desktop dialog choosing a folder; web zipping with progress and cancel.
Todos: E3h, E3i

n17.text:
O17 Phone: organise pages
Select pages in a grid and act on them from the bottom action bar; reorder with Move to.
States: 2 pages selected; Move to sheet.
Todos: E2h
